name: Senior managers (public & private)
official_noc_title: Senior managers - public and private sector (Census grouping 00011-00015)
rationale: Senior leaders spend most of their time on strategy, stakeholder relationships and accountability, which AI supports but does not replace. Reporting, analysis and briefing work beneath them is increasingly AI-assisted.

name: Financial managers
rationale: Financial reporting, budgeting and analysis are digital and increasingly automated. Judgment on policy, controls and advising executives keeps the role, but fewer staff are needed around it.

name: Human resources managers
rationale: Recruitment screening, policy drafting and HR analytics are highly AI-assisted. Collective bargaining, conflict resolution and people leadership remain human work.

name: Marketing & PR managers
official_noc_title: Advertising, marketing and public relations managers
rationale: Campaign content, targeting and performance analysis are areas where AI is advancing fast. Brand strategy, client relationships and team leadership remain central.

name: Computer & IS managers
rationale: Managing software, networks and systems work is being transformed as AI speeds up the teams they lead. Vendor decisions, security accountability and people management keep the role anchored.

name: School principals
official_noc_title: School principals and administrators of elementary and secondary education
rationale: Principals lead staff and students in a physical school and handle community and safety issues in person. Scheduling, reporting and administrative work is AI-assisted.

name: Corporate sales managers
rationale: Forecasting, CRM analysis and sales content are increasingly automated. Leading sales teams and managing major client relationships remain human work.

name: Construction managers
rationale: Estimating, scheduling and documentation are increasingly AI-assisted. Site coordination, safety accountability and managing trades in person keep the role grounded.

name: Manufacturing managers
rationale: Production planning and reporting benefit from AI. Running a plant floor, managing people and responding to operational problems require presence and judgment.

name: Financial auditors & accountants
rationale: Bookkeeping review, tax preparation and audit testing are digital and increasingly automated. Professional judgment, assurance sign-off and client advising remain human responsibilities.

name: Financial & investment analysts
rationale: Financial modelling, research and report writing are core AI strengths, and the work is almost entirely digital. Senior judgment persists, but junior analytical work is highly exposed.

name: Financial advisors
rationale: Portfolio analysis and planning documents are increasingly AI-generated. Trust, goal-setting conversations and client relationships are the core product.

name: HR professionals
rationale: Job postings, screening, policy writing and benefits administration are digital and AI-assisted. Employee relations and sensitive conversations remain human.

name: Business management consultants
official_noc_title: Professional occupations in business management consulting
rationale: Research, analysis and slide and report production are highly exposed to AI. Client relationships and implementation support remain valuable.

name: Marketing & PR professionals
official_noc_title: Professional occupations in advertising, marketing and public relations
rationale: Copywriting, content creation, campaign analysis and media monitoring are almost entirely digital and squarely in AI's range. Strategy and relationship work is more durable.

name: Procurement & purchasing agents
official_noc_title: Procurement and purchasing agents and officers
rationale: Supplier research, bid comparison and contract administration are digital and increasingly automated. Negotiation and supplier relationships remain human.

name: Accounting technicians & bookkeepers
rationale: Recording transactions, reconciling accounts and preparing statements is rule-based digital work that AI and accounting software can already do. Very little of the role requires presence.

name: Administrative officers
rationale: Coordinating records, budgets, correspondence and office procedures is largely digital and routine. AI tools can draft, track and process much of this work.

name: Payroll administrators
rationale: Payroll calculation, deductions and record keeping are rule-based digital processing. Software and AI already handle most of the core tasks.

name: Administrative assistants
rationale: Drafting correspondence, scheduling, and managing documents are digital tasks that AI assistants now handle well. Some coordination and in-person office support remains.

name: Receptionists
rationale: Answering calls, booking appointments and directing inquiries are increasingly handled by AI phone and scheduling tools. Greeting visitors in person keeps part of the role physical.

name: Accounting & financial clerks
rationale: Data entry, invoicing and reconciling accounts are routine digital work. AI and accounting automation can already perform most of these tasks.

name: Banking & insurance clerks
official_noc_title: Banking, insurance and other financial clerks
rationale: Processing transactions, claims and financial records is routine digital work. Automation and AI are steadily absorbing the core tasks.

name: Insurance agents & brokers
rationale: Quoting, comparing policies and processing applications are increasingly automated. Advising clients and maintaining relationships keep part of the role human.

name: Real estate agents
rationale: Listings, market analysis and paperwork are AI-assisted. Showings, negotiation and guiding clients through major decisions happen in person.

name: Customer services reps - financial
rationale: Answering account questions and processing routine transactions are prime targets for AI chat and self-service tools. In-branch service keeps some of the role physical.

name: Customer & info services reps
official_noc_title: Other customer and information services representatives
rationale: Answering inquiries, providing information and resolving routine issues by phone or chat is exactly what AI agents are being deployed to do. The work is almost entirely digital.

name: Geoscientists
rationale: Data interpretation, modelling and reporting are strongly AI-assisted. Field sampling and site work add a physical component.

name: Public health & safety professionals
official_noc_title: Public and environmental health and safety professionals
rationale: Inspections and site investigations require physical presence. Analysis, reporting and regulatory writing are AI-assisted.

name: Architects
rationale: Design generation, drafting and documentation are increasingly AI-assisted. Client consultation, approvals and professional liability keep architects central.

name: Data scientists
rationale: Analysis, modelling and coding are digital tasks where AI is highly capable. Problem framing and interpreting results for decisions remain valuable.

name: Cybersecurity specialists
rationale: Monitoring, threat analysis and incident response are digital work being rapidly reshaped by AI on both the attack and defence side. Human judgment stays essential, but the work changes substantially.

name: Software engineers & designers
rationale: Designing and building software is digital work where AI coding tools are transforming productivity. System design and accountability for complex systems keep engineers central.

name: Software developers
rationale: Writing, testing and maintaining code is squarely in AI's strongest domain. Demand for software may still grow, but the day-to-day work is being restructured.

name: Web developers
rationale: Building and maintaining websites and applications is fully digital work that AI tools now do quickly. Standard builds are especially exposed.

name: Civil engineers
rationale: Design calculations, modelling and documentation are AI-assisted. Site review, approvals and professional sign-off remain human responsibilities.

name: Mechanical engineers
rationale: Design, simulation and documentation are increasingly AI-assisted. Testing, manufacturing problems and physical prototypes keep the work grounded.

name: Computer network technicians
rationale: Configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting networks and websites is largely digital and increasingly automated. Some hardware and on-site work remains.

name: User support technicians
rationale: Answering technical questions and resolving routine user problems is a leading use case for AI help desks. In-person hardware support is a smaller share of the work.

name: Medical transcriptionists & court reporters
official_noc_title: Court reporters, medical transcriptionists and related occupations
rationale: Transcribing dictation and recorded proceedings is routine, fully digital work. Speech-to-text AI can already do most of it.

name: Health information management
rationale: Coding, abstracting and managing health records is digital, rule-based work that AI handles well. Privacy compliance and quality review add some resilience.

name: Clinical & lab medicine specialists
official_noc_title: Specialists in clinical and laboratory medicine
rationale: This group includes lab medicine and imaging specialties where AI interpretation is advancing, alongside hands-on clinical specialties. Clinical accountability and complex judgment keep physicians central.

name: Surgeons
rationale: Surgery is hands-on, high-stakes physical work. AI helps with planning, imaging and documentation, but not the core of the job.

name: General practitioners
rationale: Documentation, triage and diagnostic support are increasingly AI-assisted. Physical examination, relationships and clinical accountability keep the role central.

name: Dentists
rationale: Dentistry is precise manual work done chairside. AI assists with imaging and records, not treatment.

name: Pharmacists
rationale: Dispensing checks, drug interaction review and documentation are increasingly automated. Patient counselling and clinical services remain human.

name: Psychologists
rationale: Assessment reports and some structured interventions are AI-assisted. The therapeutic relationship at the centre of the work is human.

name: Physiotherapists
rationale: Treatment is hands-on and physical. AI helps with assessment tracking and documentation.

name: Occupational therapists
rationale: Therapy is built on physical and interpersonal work with clients. AI touches assessment and paperwork.

name: Registered nurses
official_noc_title: Registered nurses and registered psychiatric nurses
rationale: Direct patient care and clinical judgment at the bedside are physical and interpersonal. Charting and care coordination are increasingly AI-assisted.

name: Nurse practitioners
rationale: Diagnosis, prescribing and documentation involve substantial knowledge work that AI supports. Physical examination and patient relationships remain central.

name: Licensed practical nurses
rationale: The role is mostly direct, hands-on patient care. AI mainly affects documentation.

name: Paramedics
rationale: Emergency response is physical, real-time work in unpredictable settings. AI touches only reporting and dispatch support.

name: Dental hygienists
rationale: Cleaning and assessment are manual and done in person. AI affects scheduling and records only.

name: Medical lab technologists
rationale: Analyzers and AI image tools are automating parts of test interpretation. Sample handling, quality control and validation still require trained staff.

name: Nurse aides & personal support
official_noc_title: Nurse aides, orderlies and patient service associates
rationale: The work is physical care and assistance with daily living. AI has little effect on the core tasks.

name: Government managers (health & social policy)
official_noc_title: Government managers - health and social policy development and program administration
rationale: Policy analysis, program design and reporting are knowledge work strongly assisted by AI. Accountability, stakeholder work and managing staff remain human.

name: Lawyers & notaries
rationale: Legal research, drafting and document review are core AI strengths. Advocacy, negotiation and client counsel keep lawyers central.

name: University professors
rationale: Research, course preparation and grading are increasingly AI-assisted. Teaching, mentoring and original research leadership remain human.

name: College & vocational instructors
rationale: Course content and assessment are AI-assisted. Much vocational instruction is hands-on and delivered in person.

name: Secondary school teachers
rationale: Lesson planning, feedback and grading are increasingly AI-assisted. Classroom teaching and relationships with students remain central.

name: Elementary & kindergarten teachers
rationale: Planning and assessment are AI-assisted. Supervising and teaching young children in person is the heart of the job.

name: Social workers
rationale: Case notes, assessments and resource navigation are AI-assisted. Building trust and supporting people through crises is human work.

name: Business development & market analysts
official_noc_title: Business development officers and market researchers and analysts
rationale: Market research, data analysis and report writing are almost entirely digital and highly exposed. Relationship-driven business development is more durable.

name: Paralegals
rationale: Legal research, drafting and document review are among the most AI-exposed knowledge tasks. The role is being restructured quickly.

name: Early childhood educators
rationale: Caring for and teaching young children requires constant physical presence. AI touches only planning and records.

name: Correctional officers
rationale: Supervising inmates and maintaining safety is physical, in-person work. AI affects monitoring and reports only.

name: Librarians
rationale: Information retrieval, cataloguing and research help are increasingly handled by AI. Community programming and in-person services remain.

name: Editors
rationale: Reviewing, rewriting and preparing text for publication is digital work where AI is now highly capable. The role is facing major restructuring.

name: Authors & writers
rationale: Producing written content is a core AI capability. Original voice, reporting and creative work are more durable than routine writing.

name: Technical writers
rationale: Manuals, documentation and technical guides are structured digital writing that AI produces well. Domain expertise and review remain.

name: Journalists
rationale: Writing, research and routine news production are highly exposed. Field reporting, sourcing and investigation keep journalists in the world.

name: Translators & interpreters
rationale: Machine translation has improved dramatically and handles most routine translation. Interpretation in person and high-stakes legal or literary work are more resilient.

name: Musicians & singers
rationale: Live performance is human and physical. AI composition and production tools compete with recorded and commercial work.

name: Graphic designers & illustrators
rationale: Design and illustration are digital work where generative AI now produces competitive output. Brand-level creative direction is more durable.

name: Photographers
rationale: Image generation competes with stock and commercial photography. Events, portraits and on-location work still require a photographer.

name: Home child care providers
rationale: Caring for children in a home is physical, continuous and interpersonal. AI has essentially no effect on the core work.

name: Chefs
rationale: Cooking and running a kitchen is hands-on physical work. AI touches menu planning, costing and ordering.

name: Cooks
rationale: Food preparation is manual work in a fast-moving physical environment. AI has little effect on the core tasks.

name: Hairstylists & barbers
rationale: Cutting and styling hair is skilled manual work with a personal relationship at its centre. AI has almost no effect on the work.

name: Retail salespersons
rationale: Product recommendations and online shopping are increasingly AI-driven. In-store selling, merchandising and customer service remain physical and interpersonal.

name: Hotel front desk clerks
rationale: Reservations, check-in and guest inquiries are increasingly handled by apps and AI tools. In-person guest service and problem solving remain.

name: Security guards
official_noc_title: Security guards and related security service occupations
rationale: Patrolling and responding to incidents is physical work. AI-powered monitoring changes how surveillance is done.

name: Cashiers
rationale: Handling payments is routine but physical and in-person. Self-checkout is automation rather than AI, and digital AI touches little of the job.

name: Food counter attendants
official_noc_title: Food counter attendants, kitchen helpers and related support occupations
rationale: Serving food and kitchen support is physical, fast-paced work. AI affects ordering systems, not the core tasks.

name: Travel counsellors
rationale: Researching and booking travel is digital work that AI agents and booking platforms handle well. Specialized and complex trip planning survives.

name: Taxi & limousine drivers
official_noc_title: Taxi and limousine drivers and chauffeurs
rationale: Driving is physical, real-time work. Dispatch and routing are AI-driven; autonomous vehicles are a separate, longer-term risk not scored here.

name: Delivery drivers
official_noc_title: Delivery service drivers and door-to-door distributors
rationale: Delivery is physical work in variable urban environments. AI shapes routing and scheduling only.

name: Welders
rationale: Welding is skilled manual work, often in varied field conditions. AI touches only planning and documentation.

name: Electricians
rationale: Installing and repairing wiring in varied buildings is hands-on work. AI helps only with paperwork, estimates and code lookup.

name: Plumbers
rationale: Plumbing is hands-on problem solving in confined, variable spaces. AI touches only estimates and scheduling.

name: Carpenters
rationale: Carpentry is skilled physical work adapted to each site. AI affects planning and estimates only.

name: HVAC mechanics
official_noc_title: Heating, refrigeration and air conditioning mechanics
rationale: Installing and servicing heating and cooling systems is physical work in varied settings. AI helps with diagnostics and paperwork.

name: Auto mechanics
official_noc_title: Automotive service technicians, truck and bus mechanics and mechanical repairers
rationale: Diagnostics are increasingly computer and AI-assisted. The repair work itself is physical and hands-on.

name: Air pilots
official_noc_title: Air pilots, flight engineers and flying instructors
rationale: Flying requires real-time judgment and regulatory accountability in the cockpit. AI supports planning and systems monitoring.

name: Transport truck drivers
rationale: Driving a truck is physical, real-time work. Routing and logs are digital; autonomous trucking is a separate, slower risk not scored here.

name: Bus & transit drivers
official_noc_title: Bus drivers, subway operators and other transit operators
rationale: Operating a bus or train is real-time physical work with public interaction. AI affects scheduling and routing.

name: Heavy equipment operators
rationale: Operating heavy machinery on variable terrain is physical, skilled work. AI mainly affects planning and telematics.

name: Construction labourers
rationale: Construction labour is physical work in constantly changing site conditions. Digital AI has essentially no effect on the core tasks.

name: Farm managers
rationale: Running a farm is physical, weather-dependent work. AI helps with precision agriculture data, planning and business decisions.

name: Underground miners
rationale: Underground mining is physical work in hazardous, variable conditions. Digital AI has essentially no effect on the core tasks.

name: Oil & gas drillers
official_noc_title: Oil and gas well drillers, servicers, testers and related workers
rationale: Drilling and servicing wells is physical field work. Digital AI touches only data and reporting.

name: Fishers
rationale: Commercial fishing is physical work in unpredictable conditions at sea. Digital AI has essentially no effect on the job.

name: Logging workers
rationale: Operating chain saws and skidders in the forest is physical work on rough terrain. Digital AI has essentially no effect.

name: Landscaping labourers
rationale: Landscaping and grounds work is physical and outdoors. Digital AI has essentially no effect on the core tasks.

name: Machinists
official_noc_title: Machinists and machining and tooling inspectors
rationale: CNC programming and inspection data are increasingly digital. Setting up and running machines and precision work remain hands-on.

name: Industrial electricians
rationale: Installing and repairing industrial electrical equipment is physical, specialized work. AI helps with diagnostics and documentation.

name: Heavy-duty equipment mechanics
rationale: Repairing heavy equipment is hands-on, often in the field. AI assists diagnostics only.

name: Material handlers & warehouse workers
rationale: Loading, unloading and moving materials is physical work. Warehouse robotics is separate from digital AI, which touches little of the job.

name: Power engineers
official_noc_title: Power engineers and power systems operators
rationale: Monitoring and control systems are increasingly digital and AI-assisted. Licensed operation, safety response and equipment work require trained people on site.

name: Industrial butchers & meat cutters
official_noc_title: Industrial butchers and meat cutters, poultry preparers and related workers
rationale: Cutting and preparing meat is manual work. Digital AI has essentially no effect on the core tasks.

name: Industrial sewing & textile operators
rationale: Operating industrial sewing machines is manual production work. Digital AI has essentially no effect.

name: Motor vehicle assemblers
official_noc_title: Motor vehicle assemblers, inspectors and testers
rationale: Assembling and inspecting vehicles on a production line is physical work. Robotics is separate from digital AI, which touches little of the job.
